lines.1: 「Come on... Pant, pant... Just come with us for a minute... Okay?」
lines.3: 「What, you can't grant a senior's request? Ryuumeikan has a pretty strict pecking order, you know.」
lines.5: 「Come on, come on. Your parents never have to know.」
lines.6: 「What the hell is wrong with you?!」
lines.7: Kinu and Subaru's tandem middle kicks struck Fukahire.
lines.8: They sent him flying all the way to the school-gate fence.
lines.9: 「I'm sorry about that. Please forget what just happened. Here, have some biscuits.」
lines.10: I gave them some of my anti-Kinu biscuit supply as an apology.
lines.13: 「Don't get in my way! I almost had them!」
lines.15: Crab delivered the perfect retort from the perfect angle.
lines.18: 「Fine, fine. I'll admit I got carried away.」
lines.19: 「I guess whenever I see a girl, I immediately picture her naked in my head.」
lines.20: 「Stop talking. You're only making your position worse.」
